source.label: NEXUS v13와 선택된 Rhino 최종 모델 비교

files.label: NEXUS 1918 최종 통합 스페이스 프로그램 v13 · 2026.10.11

filters: 현재 선택 객체 3,947개 중 건축 매스 157개
같은 높이 구간의 겹치는 면적은 한 번 합산
caveats: 면적은 1좌표 단위=1m로 해석했다. Rhino 선언 단위는 Millimeters이지만 주거 매스 48×10 및 기존 면적 속성이 m 스케일과 일치한다.
모델 면적은 선택한 건축 매스의 층별 수평 바닥면 합집합이다. 법정 연면적이나 실별 면적을 확정한 값이 아니다.
기존 역사 상세 Mesh·유리 지붕·식재·야외 지면·용도 불명 연결 요소는 건축 합계에서 제외했다.
기능을 묶어 비교한 항목은 내부 실 배정이 확인되지 않았다. 미확인 값은 0으로 처리하지 않았다.

evidenceFlow.title: 모델 추출
evidenceFlow.detail: provider: Rhino MCP; tool: run_python; slot: axolotl. 현재 선택 중 건축물 레이어의 닫힌 Brep/Extrusion 157개에서 수평 바닥면을 추출했다. 원 실행 코드는 query.methods에 보존했다.

evidenceFlow.title: v13 목표 정리
evidenceFlow.detail: 사용자가 붙여넣은 v13 문서에서 시설 목표 연면적을 취합했다. 조건부 수영장 1,800㎡와 영화관 800㎡를 포함하면 105,560㎡, 제외하면 102,960㎡다.

evidenceFlow.title: 교차 검산
evidenceFlow.detail: 기능별 합집합 합계와 전체 합집합 합계가 0.000001㎡ 이내로 일치했다. 157개 매스를 체적÷높이로 대조한 최대 면적 오차는 0.000042㎡였다.

metricDefinitions.label: 비교 면적 (㎡)
metricDefinitions.definition: v13 시설 목표 합계와 현재 선택한 건축 매스의 층별 수평 바닥면 합집합을 비교했다. 증감률=(모델−v13)/v13×100.

import Rhino, json, math, re
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
from System.Collections.Generic import List
doc=__rhino_doc__
sel=list(doc.Objects.GetSelectedObjects(False,False))
outdir=Path(r'C:\Users\OFFICE\Desktop\9_도시\work\nexus_v13_audit_20261011')
outdir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
origin=Rhino.Geometry.Point3d(1166700,1761100,0)
records=[]; caps=defaultdict(list); failures=[]
for o in sel:
 layer=doc.Layers[o.Attributes.LayerIndex].FullPath
 if "::06_" not in layer: continue
 g=o.Geometry
 if isinstance(g,Rhino.Geometry.Extrusion): b=g.ToBrep()
 elif isinstance(g,Rhino.Geometry.Brep): b=g.DuplicateBrep()
 else: continue
 bb=g.GetBoundingBox(True)
 us=o.Attributes.GetUserStrings()
 meta={str(k):str(us[k]) for k in us.AllKeys} if us else {}
 name=meta.get('건축물') or re.sub(r' \d+F$','',o.Attributes.Name or '(unnamed)')
 bottom=[]
 for f in b.Faces:
  fb=f.GetBoundingBox(True)
  if abs(fb.Max.Z-fb.Min.Z)<1e-5 and abs(fb.Min.Z-bb.Min.Z)<1e-5:
   c=f.DuplicateFace(False)
   c.Transform(Rhino.Geometry.Transform.Translation(-origin.X,-origin.Y,-bb.Min.Z))
   bottom.append(c)
 raw=sum(Rhino.Geometry.AreaMassProperties.Compute(c).Area for c in bottom)
 if not bottom:failures.append({'id':str(o.Id),'name':name,'reason':'no horizontal bottom'})
 key=(name,round(bb.Min.Z,5),round(bb.Max.Z,5))
 caps[key].extend(bottom)
 record={'id':str(o.Id),'object_name':o.Attributes.Name,'building':name,'layer':layer,'category':meta.get('용도분류',''),'zmin':bb.Min.Z,'zmax':bb.Max.Z,'dimensions':[bb.Max.X-bb.Min.X,bb.Max.Y-bb.Min.Y,bb.Max.Z-bb.Min.Z],'bottom_area':raw,'is_solid':bool(b.IsSolid),'metadata':meta}
 records.append(record)
floor_rows=[]; global_caps=defaultdict(list)
for key,items in caps.items():
 arr=List[Rhino.Geometry.Brep](items)
 merged=Rhino.Geometry.Brep.CreatePlanarUnion(arr,Rhino.Geometry.Plane.WorldXY,0.0001)
 if merged is None or len(merged)==0:
  merged=items; failures.append({'name':key[0],'z':key[1],'reason':'union failed; raw sum used'})
 area=sum(Rhino.Geometry.AreaMassProperties.Compute(c).Area for c in merged)
 floor_rows.append({'building':key[0],'zmin':key[1],'zmax':key[2],'raw_area':sum(Rhino.Geometry.AreaMassProperties.Compute(c).Area for c in items),'union_area':area,'parts':len(items),'union_parts':len(merged)})
 global_caps[(key[1],key[2])].extend(merged)
global_rows=[]
for key,items in global_caps.items():
 merged=Rhino.Geometry.Brep.CreatePlanarUnion(List[Rhino.Geometry.Brep](items),Rhino.Geometry.Plane.WorldXY,0.0001)
 if merged is None or len(merged)==0: merged=items;failures.append({'zrange':list(key),'reason':'global union failed'})
 global_rows.append({'zmin':key[0],'zmax':key[1],'area':sum(Rhino.Geometry.AreaMassProperties.Compute(c).Area for c in merged),'raw_area':sum(Rhino.Geometry.AreaMassProperties.Compute(c).Area for c in items)})
buildings=[]
for name in sorted(set(r['building'] for r in records)):
 rows=[r for r in floor_rows if r['building']==name]; rs=[r for r in records if r['building']==name]
 buildings.append({'building':name,'category':rs[0]['category'],'objects':len(rs),'actual_floor_count':len(rows),'z_intervals':[[r['zmin'],r['zmax']] for r in sorted(rows,key=lambda a:a['zmin'])],'floor_areas':[round(r['union_area'],4) for r in sorted(rows,key=lambda a:a['zmin'])],'gfa':sum(r['union_area'] for r in rows),'raw_gfa':sum(r['raw_area'] for r in rows),'metadata_gfa':rs[0]['metadata'].get('연면적㎡'),'metadata_floors':rs[0]['metadata'].get('층수')})
data={'document':doc.Name,'path':doc.Path,'declared_unit':str(doc.ModelUnitSystem),'physical_interpretation':'one coordinate unit interpreted as one meter based on 48x10 housing and 25x100 city hall dimensions, metadata and source program','selection_count':len(sel),'building_object_count':len(records),'records':records,'floors':floor_rows,'buildings':buildings,'global_floors':global_rows,'total_building_union_gfa':sum(r['gfa'] for r in buildings),'global_union_gfa':sum(r['area'] for r in global_rows),'failures':failures}
(outdir/'rhino_measurements.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({k:data[k] for k in ['document','declared_unit','selection_count','building_object_count','buildings','total_building_union_gfa','global_union_gfa','failures']},ensure_ascii=False))

import Rhino,json,re
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict
from System.Collections.Generic import List
doc=__rhino_doc__;sel=list(doc.Objects.GetSelectedObjects(False,False))
root=Path(r'C:\Users\OFFICE\Desktop\9_도시\work\nexus_v13_audit_20261011')
data=json.loads((root/'rhino_measurements.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
def category(name):
 if name in ['공공청사 본관','공공청사 민원·시민홀동']:return '청사'
 if name in ['공공기관 업무동','청년창업지원센터']:return '기관·청년창업'
 if name=='공공청사·기관 직원 주차장동':return '북측 주차'
 if re.match(r'^주거동 \d+$',name):return '주거'
 if name=='생활체육관·편의시설':return '스포츠·생활편의'
 if name in ['복합문화센터','생활가로 상가']:return '중앙 북측 복합문화·상가'
 if name=='건강·돌봄센터':return '건강·돌봄'
 if name in ['실내 공예마켓·운영동','전통문화 공방·체험·전시동']:return '서측 공예전시·마켓·공방'
 if name=='작가 교류·행사동':return '작가 교류'
 if name.startswith('레지던시 거주동') or name.startswith('레지던시 제작동'):return '레지던시'
 if name=='실내 체험관':return '실내 체험'
 if name in ['근대역사관','지역문화원 본동','소상공인 상생동(남)','소상공인 상생동(북)']:return '남측 역사문화·상생'
 if name=='관광지원센터':return '관광지원'
 if name=='공유주차장':return '남측 공유주차'
 if name=='모빌리티 허브':return '모빌리티 허브'
 if name in ['레지던시 가로상가','관문 가로상가']:return '별도 가로상가'
 return name
caps=defaultdict(list);records={r['id']:r for r in data['records']}
volume_check=[]
for o in sel:
 if str(o.Id) not in records:continue
 r=records[str(o.Id)];g=o.Geometry
 b=g.ToBrep() if isinstance(g,Rhino.Geometry.Extrusion) else g.DuplicateBrep()
 bb=b.GetBoundingBox(True);b.Transform(Rhino.Geometry.Transform.Translation(-1166700,-1761100,0))
 v=Rhino.Geometry.VolumeMassProperties.Compute(b)
 area_from_volume=abs(v.Volume)/(bb.Max.Z-bb.Min.Z) if v else None
 volume_check.append({'id':str(o.Id),'name':r['building'],'bottom_area':r['bottom_area'],'volume_over_height':area_from_volume,'error':abs(area_from_volume-r['bottom_area']) if area_from_volume is not None else None})
 for f in b.Faces:
  fb=f.GetBoundingBox(True)
  if abs(fb.Max.Z-fb.Min.Z)<1e-5 and abs(fb.Min.Z-bb.Min.Z)<1e-5:
   face=f.DuplicateFace(False);face.Transform(Rhino.Geometry.Transform.Translation(0,0,-bb.Min.Z))
   caps[(category(r['building']),round(bb.Min.Z,5),round(bb.Max.Z,5))].append(face)
group_sums=defaultdict(float);group_floors=[]
for (name,z1,z2),parts in caps.items():
 merged=Rhino.Geometry.Brep.CreatePlanarUnion(List[Rhino.Geometry.Brep](parts),Rhino.Geometry.Plane.WorldXY,0.0001)
 area=sum(Rhino.Geometry.AreaMassProperties.Compute(x).Area for x in merged)
 group_sums[name]+=area;group_floors.append({'group':name,'zmin':z1,'zmax':z2,'area':area})
site_rows=[]
for o in sel:
 l=doc.Layers[o.Attributes.LayerIndex].FullPath;g=o.Geometry
 if isinstance(g,Rhino.Geometry.Curve) and g.IsClosed and ('00_' in l or '01_' in l or '02_' in l or '03_' in l or '08_' in l):
  crv=g.DuplicateCurve();crv.Transform(Rhino.Geometry.Transform.Translation(-1166700,-1761100,0))
  ap=Rhino.Geometry.AreaMassProperties.Compute(crv)
  if ap:site_rows.append({'id':str(o.Id),'name':o.Attributes.Name,'layer':l,'area':ap.Area})
result={'group_gfa':dict(group_sums),'group_floors':group_floors,'group_sum_before_cross_group_overlap':sum(group_sums.values()),'global_union_gfa':data['global_union_gfa'],'remaining_cross_group_overlap':sum(group_sums.values())-data['global_union_gfa'],'volume_checks':volume_check,'max_volume_check_error':max(v['error'] for v in volume_check if v['error'] is not None),'site_rows':site_rows}
(root/'comparison_groups.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'group_gfa':dict(group_sums),'group_sum':sum(group_sums.values()),'global_union_gfa':data['global_union_gfa'],'remaining_cross_group_overlap':result['remaining_cross_group_overlap'],'max_volume_check_error':result['max_volume_check_error'],'volume_nonprismatic':[v for v in volume_check if v['error'] is not None and v['error']>0.01],'site_rows':site_rows},ensure_ascii=False))

rows.note: 기본 48×10·5층·8동은 일치; 겹침 제외 1층 연결부 960㎡ 추가

실내 공예마켓·운영동 + 전통문화 공방·체험·전시동; 기능을 묶어 비교
근대역사관 + 지역문화원 + 소상공인 상생동 묶음; 수장고·기획전시·기록·사업화의 실별 배정 미확인

생활가로·레지던시·관문 가로상가; v13의 편의·마켓 안에서 수용 여부 미확인

filters: 현재 선택 객체 3,947개 중 건축 매스 157개
같은 높이 구간의 겹치는 면적은 한 번 합산
caveats: 면적은 1좌표 단위=1m로 해석했다. Rhino 선언 단위는 Millimeters이지만 주거 매스 48×10 및 기존 면적 속성이 m 스케일과 일치한다.
모델 면적은 선택한 건축 매스의 층별 수평 바닥면 합집합이다. 법정 연면적이나 실별 면적을 확정한 값이 아니다.
기존 역사 상세 Mesh·유리 지붕·식재·야외 지면·용도 불명 연결 요소는 건축 합계에서 제외했다.
기능을 묶어 비교한 항목은 내부 실 배정이 확인되지 않았다. 미확인 값은 0으로 처리하지 않았다.

import Rhino, json, math, re
from pathlib import Path

from System.Collections.Generic import List
doc=__rhino_doc__
sel=list(doc.Objects.GetSelectedObjects(False,False))
outdir=Path(r'C:\Users\OFFICE\Desktop\9_도시\work\nexus_v13_audit_20261011')
outdir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
origin=Rhino.Geometry.Point3d(1166700,1761100,0)
records=[]; caps=defaultdict(list); failures=[]
for o in sel:
 layer=doc.Layers[o.Attributes.LayerIndex].FullPath
 if "::06_" not in layer: continue
 g=o.Geometry
 if isinstance(g,Rhino.Geometry.Extrusion): b=g.ToBrep()
 elif isinstance(g,Rhino.Geometry.Brep): b=g.DuplicateBrep()
 else: continue
 bb=g.GetBoundingBox(True)
 us=o.Attributes.GetUserStrings()
 meta={str(k):str(us[k]) for k in us.AllKeys} if us else {}
 name=meta.get('건축물') or re.sub(r' \d+F$','',o.Attributes.Name or '(unnamed)')
 bottom=[]
 for f in b.Faces:
  fb=f.GetBoundingBox(True)
  if abs(fb.Max.Z-fb.Min.Z)<1e-5 and abs(fb.Min.Z-bb.Min.Z)<1e-5:
   c=f.DuplicateFace(False)
   c.Transform(Rhino.Geometry.Transform.Translation(-origin.X,-origin.Y,-bb.Min.Z))
   bottom.append(c)
 raw=sum(Rhino.Geometry.AreaMassProperties.Compute(c).Area for c in bottom)
 if not bottom:failures.append({'id':str(o.Id),'name':name,'reason':'no horizontal bottom'})
 key=(name,round(bb.Min.Z,5),round(bb.Max.Z,5))
 caps[key].extend(bottom)
 record={'id':str(o.Id),'object_name':o.Attributes.Name,'building':name,'layer':layer,'category':meta.get('용도분류',''),'zmin':bb.Min.Z,'zmax':bb.Max.Z,'dimensions':[bb.Max.X-bb.Min.X,bb.Max.Y-bb.Min.Y,bb.Max.Z-bb.Min.Z],'bottom_area':raw,'is_solid':bool(b.IsSolid),'metadata':meta}
 records.append(record)
floor_rows=[]; global_caps=defaultdict(list)
for key,items in caps.items():
 arr=List[Rhino.Geometry.Brep](items)
 merged=Rhino.Geometry.Brep.CreatePlanarUnion(arr,Rhino.Geometry.Plane.WorldXY,0.0001)
 if merged is None or len(merged)==0:
  merged=items; failures.append({'name':key[0],'z':key[1],'reason':'union failed; raw sum used'})
 area=sum(Rhino.Geometry.AreaMassProperties.Compute(c).Area for c in merged)
 floor_rows.append({'building':key[0],'zmin':key[1],'zmax':key[2],'raw_area':sum(Rhino.Geometry.AreaMassProperties.Compute(c).Area for c in items),'union_area':area,'parts':len(items),'union_parts':len(merged)})
 global_caps[(key[1],key[2])].extend(merged)
global_rows=[]
for key,items in global_caps.items():
 merged=Rhino.Geometry.Brep.CreatePlanarUnion(List[Rhino.Geometry.Brep](items),Rhino.Geometry.Plane.WorldXY,0.0001)
 if merged is None or len(merged)==0: merged=items;failures.append({'zrange':list(key),'reason':'global union failed'})
 global_rows.append({'zmin':key[0],'zmax':key[1],'area':sum(Rhino.Geometry.AreaMassProperties.Compute(c).Area for c in merged),'raw_area':sum(Rhino.Geometry.AreaMassProperties.Compute(c).Area for c in items)})
buildings=[]
for name in sorted(set(r['building'] for r in records)):
 rows=[r for r in floor_rows if r['building']==name]; rs=[r for r in records if r['building']==name]
 buildings.append({'building':name,'category':rs[0]['category'],'objects':len(rs),'actual_floor_count':len(rows),'z_intervals':[[r['zmin'],r['zmax']] for r in sorted(rows,key=lambda a:a['zmin'])],'floor_areas':[round(r['union_area'],4) for r in sorted(rows,key=lambda a:a['zmin'])],'gfa':sum(r['union_area'] for r in rows),'raw_gfa':sum(r['raw_area'] for r in rows),'metadata_gfa':rs[0]['metadata'].get('연면적㎡'),'metadata_floors':rs[0]['metadata'].get('층수')})
data={'document':doc.Name,'path':doc.Path,'declared_unit':str(doc.ModelUnitSystem),'physical_interpretation':'one coordinate unit interpreted as one meter based on 48x10 housing and 25x100 city hall dimensions, metadata and source program','selection_count':len(sel),'building_object_count':len(records),'records':records,'floors':floor_rows,'buildings':buildings,'global_floors':global_rows,'total_building_union_gfa':sum(r['gfa'] for r in buildings),'global_union_gfa':sum(r['area'] for r in global_rows),'failures':failures}
(outdir/'rhino_measurements.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({k:data[k] for k in ['document','declared_unit','selection_count','building_object_count','buildings','total_building_union_gfa','global_union_gfa','failures']},ensure_ascii=False))
